visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A dot plot with a tight cluster and one isolated dot, with summary plates that appear on demand. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / slate-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Dot plot board: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Dots: small warm-ink spheres; cluster dots slightly smaller, outlier dot one size larger with a small question-mark flag. Summary plates: three flat warm paper plates (mean, range, median) popping up on demand. Magnifier: thin warm-grey ring when inspecting. Distance tag: small warm paper tag updating with position. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the outlier and its effects — a dot plot with a tight cluster and one far dot; dragging the outlier changes a distance tag; 'show effects' lights up mean/range/median plates to show how summaries respond; 'inspect' magnifies the point to ask real-event vs typo.

GEOMETRY: A dot plot board with a cluster of dots in the middle and a single dot far off to the right, wearing a small question-mark flag. Dragging the lone dot moves it and a distance tag reads the gap. 'Show effects' reveals three plates: the mean slides toward the outlier, the range arrow stretches to the far dot, and the median line stays in the cluster. 'Inspect' brings a magnifier ring over the outlier and its label falls out for the learner to judge.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) cluster dots; (3) outlier dot + distance tag; (4) summary plates + magnifier.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, above, frames the plot; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: DotPlot, ClusterDots, OutlierDot, DistanceTag, MeanPlate, MedianDot, RangeArrow, Magnifier. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
